description: This file is a shell script designed to perform a network responsiveness sanity check using ping; it summarizes packet loss and RTT metrics.

methods.name: create R alias
methods.description: Defines an alias R for executing remote commands or commands with a specific environment.

methods.name: run ping and check packet loss summary
methods.description: Executes a ping command to 1.1.1.1, processes the output to extract packet loss and RTT metrics.
